ratio.description: fixed QQQ LONG PUT 1 : SPY SHORT PUT 6; entry and exit require displayed side size for every contract

entry_filter.name: none
entry_filter.description: No filter; entry when standard contract selection is available

position_size_sensitivity.method: fixed-ratio per-leg gross-P&L rescaling on the same selected contracts, quote dates and resolved cohort set; ratio sensitivity is not a fresh premium-matched selection replay; total contracts capped in displayed grid; no size-dependent market impact

HOLD_10_SESSIONS.denominator_definition: wins / resolved episodes for this policy; unresolved episodes counted separately

limitations: Public EOD preservation mirror; hashes establish file identity, not exchange or OPRA authenticity.
EOD quotes are not verified fills; displayed size is a screening gate, not guaranteed multi-leg execution.
Conservative sides: QQQ LONG enters Ask/exits Bid; SPY SHORT enters Bid/exits Ask.
Missing exit quotes/size at expiry or source end remain unresolved; win-rate denominator is resolved episodes only.
Option chain source ends in 2025; no 2026 performance is observed here.
Nominal Wilson interval does not correct for regime clustering, dependence, or prior strategy selection.
Expiry shock grid charges entry-side slippage/commission once and uses intrinsic-value payoff; exercise/assignment fees, broker margin, forced liquidation, financing and interim path are not modeled.
Equal premium debit/credit does not equalize Delta, max loss, collateral or assignment risk; SPY short put can dominate downside even when QQQ long put appreciates.
Fixed-cohort replay does not model portfolio compounding, taxes, financing, or verified fills.

When overlapping cohorts are enabled, multiple fixed-size trades can be open at once; total portfolio cash, margin, forced liquidation, and stacked assignment obligations are not constrained by this replay.
